The Foreign Ministers, reaffirming the importance of regional cooperation, expressing satisfaction with the results of the previous meeting, aware of the common challenges, decide: firstly, to set up a Joint Committee on Energy; Second, instruct the General Secretariat to prepare a report before the next meeting. 5. a) The Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs has summoned the Egyptian ambassador. · b) Egypt called its ambassador to Italy for consultations. · c) The Ministry handed over a protest note to the business officer. · d) The government has declared the diplomat person unthankful. · e) The two countries have decided to restore diplomatic relations and reopen their embassies. Exercise 6. a) They praised the level of the reports and agreed to continue the consultations on water and to hold the next session of the Joint Committee. b) The water dossier (no stated agreement) and the date of the commission (to be defined below). c) Example: The press release does not indicate any progress on the water dossier nor a date for the next meeting of the joint commission. 7. a) the following delegation (Part III of ⁧ر ف ق⁩ (c) b) bilateral talks. c) the host country (participio IV of ⁧ض ي ف⁩ ) · d) standardization (II of ⁧ط ب ع⁩ • make normal •) · e) Qatar mediation · f) stakeholders (B2-02Financial year 8 · Example. According to the statement in Part A, the talks took place in a friendly and constructive atmosphere and it was agreed to strengthen economic cooperation; the statement in Part B speaks instead of a "franco" climate and stresses that the delegation has set out its country's "stop" position on the border issue. Exercise 9. a) The President of the Republic of the Sea visits the Kingdom of the Oases; State visit of two days, the first of this type for ten years. Colloquiums on bilateral relations, energy, transport, education and regional issues; six agreements and memorandums signed, including the connection of electricity grids and the facilitation of truck transit. The press release: fraternal and constructive climate, full convergence of views on regional issues, privileged level of relations. On the water it only says that the parties have agreed to continue consultations; does not set a date for the resumption of technical negotiations. The Minister of the Kingdom speaks of dialogue as the only way to do so; his counterpart defines the water talks and in-depth discussions: the word "franchi" indicates divergences, in contrast to the tone of the joint statement. Observers: Economic success does not hide disagreement over water, postponed to preserve the positive climate. b) Preamble: four considerations ( ⁧إذ يؤكدون⁩ · ⁧وإذ يعربون⁩ · ⁧وإدراكا منهم⁩ · ⁧وإذ يرحبون⁩ ). Device: six points. 1 ⁧إنشاء⁩ : creates a fund (concrete commitment, but statute and financing referred to the Council of Ministers); 2 ⁧دعوة⁩ : calls for data to be exchanged, within the limits of national legislation (weak commitment); 3 ⁧حث⁩ : urges countries that have not yet ratified the Lake Convention (more than an invitation); 4 ⁧الإشادة⁩ : commends the secretariat's mediation and calls for dialogue; 5 ⁧تكليف⁩ : Instructs the Secretary-General to follow implementation and report; 6 ⁧عقد⁩ : next summit next year, date and place to be agreed. Submit: point 1 (Council of Ministers) 5 (Secretary-General) 6 (consultations between States). The dispute: exists between two Member States and is the subject of mediation; the text does not say which states or where mediation is at. Exercise 10. 1. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed deep concern about recent developments and called on all parties to moderate and make dialogue prevail. 2. The Foreign Minister had talks with his Spanish counterpart in the margins of the Ministerial meeting, on bilateral relations, migration and security in the Sahel. 3. The Ministry summoned the ambassador of the neighbouring country and handed him a protest note for statements that it called "a manifest interference in internal affairs." 4. The final declaration commended the mediation efforts and urged both parties to resume negotiations without preconditions. 5. The two parties agreed to continue the consultations and to set up a joint technical committee, which will have to hold its first meeting within two months. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧قلقها البالغ⁩ Deep concern is being expressed and ⁧دعت⁩ "Invited" (not "asked") in 3 the subject ⁧اعتبرتها⁩ is the ministry: the quotes remain; in 4 ⁧حث⁩ • exhorted • a step above • invite • • in 5 ⁧على أن⁩ + joint with the understanding that it will have to. Exercise 11. Personal answer. The tutor checks: official real text, with links and date of consultation; formulas and verbs correctly classified; concrete commitments distinct from generic commitments; absences found without attributing intentions; neutral Arabic summary, with attribution verbs ( ⁧أَكَّدَ البَيَانُ⁩ · ⁧دَعَا⁩ · ⁧أَعْرَبَ⁩ ). Exercise 12. a) That there are differences: the parties have said unpleasing things. Because every part writes what it wants its audience to understand. Bring them back, each with its source, and notice the difference. The first: they spoke, nothing more; The second is that I completely agree. b) These are the considerations of the preamble; in English with the gerund ('Ribando', 'Expressing'). After the preamble: "They decide on the following." That does not indicate deadlines or budget: it does not go into translation, which remains faithful, but can go into a summary. c) 1: the Minister of Foreign Affairs has completed a tour in three European capitals; talks defined as "effective" (by the Minister) on energy and migration; It is not said which capitals or with what results. 2: the Ministry has summoned the business manager of a neighbouring country and handed him a protest note for what it called the repeated airspace breach; There is still a missing version of the embassy concerned.
